GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.name: Outpost
GLOBAL.OutpostConcept.description:
Structure claiming a Province for its owner and forming the foundation for a new City.

An outpost can:Be built by a Hero.Must be in a land or water province.Cannot be built in an Uninhabitable province.Cannot be built adjacent to a province with another outpost or city.Be upgraded into a City if on land.Has various upgrades that can be built on it.Not be entered by enemies without trespassing.Grant access to Magic Material.Provide income from Node in the domain when a City establishes a Trade Route to it.

GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.name: Affinity Province Improvement
GLOBAL.AffinityProvinceImprovementConcep.description: Affinity Province Improvements are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement. Only one can be built per City, and an Empire can only build one of each. If the Seed, Root and Heart of the same affinity have been built in the Empire, the Magic Victory Spell is unlocked.

GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.name: Accuracy
GLOBAL.AccuracyConcept.description: Accuracy is the likelihood of attacks landing successfully. If the attack does not land, it misses or grazes the target.<bulletlist><bullet>Grazes deal half damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses deal no damage.</bullet><bullet>Misses can hit random adjacent units next to the target.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.name: Action Point
GLOBAL.ActionPointConcept.description:
Unit use Action Points to attack and use abilities.Units get 3 Action Points per Turn, and can use up to 2 of them to move.

Abilities use action points in different ways:

GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.name: Base
GLOBAL.BaseAbilityConcept.description:
A base attack is a normal attack that a unit can usually use every turn in combat.

Some Unit Enchantment only affect a unit's base attacks.

GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.name: Casualty
GLOBAL.CasualtyConcept.description:
When a Unit sustains damage, members of the unit are lost.

Each member lost lowers the damage output of the unit proportionally. The chance for the unit to apply Negative Status Effect is also reduced.

A Leader or Hero unit and large monsters only have a single member and are not affected by this rule.

GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.name: Charge
GLOBAL.ChargeConcept.description:
A Charge attack:Gains extra damage per hex traveled, up to Charge Hexes hexes.Cancels Defense Mode.Removes Retaliation.

These effects are negated by P R O P E R T I E S. C H A R G E_ R E S I S T A N C E, unless the attack is a P R O P E R T I E S. H E A V Y M E L E E S T R I K E.

GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.name: Combat Speed
GLOBAL.CombatSpeedConcept.description: Combat Speed represents how far a unit can move within a Turn in Combat.Each hex in combat costs {amount} point to traverse.Slowing terrain costs {amount2} points to traverse.

GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.name: Control Loss Immunity
GLOBAL.ControlLossImmunityConcept.description:
Immune to effects that make you lose control of a unit, such as P R O P E R T I E S. B E R S E R K and P R O P E R T I E S. D O M I N A T E D.
Also grants immunity to being Captured.

GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.name: Critical Hit
GLOBAL.CriticalHitConcept.description: If a unit's attack is a Critical Hit, its damage is increased by {damage}.Critical Hits are usually caused by high Unit Morale.Critical Hit chance can never be higher than an attack's chance to hit.

GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.name: Debuff
GLOBAL.DebuffConcept.description: An ability that attempts to inflict a Negative Status Effect on an enemy without directly dealing damage.

GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.name: Defense
GLOBAL.DefenseConcept.description: Defense reduces damage from Melee and Ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.name: Defense Mode
GLOBAL.DefenseModeConcept.description: Defense Mode is a Unit ability. When in Defense Mode, a unit:Extends its Zone Of Control to all adjacent hexes.Gains {defense} Defense.Gains {resistance} Resistance.Is immune to Flanking.

GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.name: Engaged in Melee
GLOBAL.EngagedInMeleeConcept.description: While within an enemy's Zone Of Control, a unit is Engaged in Melee and cannot use most ranged attacks or magical abilities.

GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.name: Evasion
GLOBAL.EvasionConcept.description: Increases chance of Ranged and ranged Magic attacks missing.

GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.name: Experience
GLOBAL.ExperienceConcept.description:
Experience points are earned by units to allow them to reach higher ranks, improving their abilities.

Units earn experience from winning battles. They also earn a small amount each turn on the world map.

GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.name: First Strike
GLOBAL.FirstStrikeConcept.description: When attacked, a unit with First Strike will use a Retaliation to attack first.

GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.name: Flanking
GLOBAL.FlankingConcept.description: Flanking attacks are triggered by attacking a target from behind or from the side.Flanking attacks deal {damage} damage.Units in Defense Mode cannot be flanked.If a unit starts its turn in an enemy's Zone Of Control, then it cannot flank it in that turn.

GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.name: Fortified
GLOBAL.FortifiedConcept.description: Can only be damaged by abilities or spells that have P R O P E R T I E S. D E M O L I S H E R.

GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.name: Fumble
GLOBAL.FumbleConcept.description: If a unit's attack is a Fumble:A hit becomes a Graze, dealing half damage.A graze becomes a miss.Fumbles are usually caused by low Unit Morale.

GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.name: Ambition
GLOBAL.AmbitionConcept.description:
Each Hero has an Ambition, which sets goals for them to complete and gain Renown. Each includes a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing these ambitions grants Renown, while completing the Major Ambition additionally grants a unique hero property.

A hero's Ambition may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete their goals in a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroClass.name: Hero Class
GLOBAL.HeroClass.description:
Each Hero has a Class, chosen during creation. Each class lets the hero specialize in particular roles and often supports two general variations on that role.

Hero Classes:Hero Class DefenderHero Class WarriorHero Class MageHero Class RitualistHero Class RangerHero Class Death KnightHero Class Spellblade

GLOBAL.HeroDedication.name: Hero Signature Skills
GLOBAL.HeroDedication.description:
At certain levels, heroes gain the ability to choose Signature skills. For Mortal Champion, Wizard King, and Dragon Lords, these take the form of Affinity Dedications.

Each tier of Affinity dedication becomes available based on the Affinity of your empire and your hero's level:
Initiate - Requires 1 affinity point and a level 4 Hero.Adept - Requires 4 affinity points and a level 8 Hero.Master - Requires 6 affinity points and a level 12 Hero. Paragon - Requires 8 affinity points and a level 16 Hero.


These Dedications grant a benefit of their own and unlock new Hero Skills.

Some Hero types such as Eldritch Sovereigns have special Signature Skills that are not related to affinity.

GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.name: Destiny
GLOBAL.DestinyConcept.description:
Each Hero has a Destiny, which sets goals for the hero to complete to gain Renown. Each Destiny has a Minor Ambition, which can be repeated any number of times, and a Major Ambition, which can only be completed once.

Completing Ambitions grants Renown, and completing Major Ambitions grants a unique hero property as well.

A Hero's destiny may be changed through an event should that hero fail to complete its ambitions for a set period of time.

GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.name: Hero Origin
GLOBAL.HeroOrigin.description:
The Origin is determined by the type of hero made during faction creation; for most randomly encountered Hero this will be Mortal Champion.

This is where skills unique to those types are found, such as breath attacks for Dragon Lords or spell enchantments for Wizard King.

GLOBAL.RenownConcept.name: Renown
GLOBAL.RenownConcept.description:
Heroes gain Renown as they complete the goals associated with their Ambition. Gaining enough renown increases their Renown Level, which increases the bonuses their Governed City gains from the hero's Governance trait.
Additionally, renown levels grant units in the hero's army additional morale and reduce the chance of losing units when Routing.

GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.name: Hero Class: Death Knight
GLOBAL.HeroClassDeathKnight.description: Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmishing Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.name: Hero Class: Defender
GLOBAL.HeroClassDefender.description: Compatible weapons:One Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmishing Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.name: Hero Class: Elementalist
GLOBAL.HeroClassMage.description: Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.name: Hero Class: Ritualist
GLOBAL.HeroClassRitualist.description: Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.name: Hero Class: Spellblade
GLOBAL.HeroClassSpellblade.description: Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmishing WeaponRanged Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.name: Hero Class: Warlock
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarlock.description: Compatible weapons:Magic Orb WeaponMagic Staff WeaponEldritch Relic Weapon

GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.name: Hero Class: Warrior
GLOBAL.HeroClassWarrior.description: Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponSkirmishing Weapon

GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.name: Adept Hero Skill
GLOBAL.AdeptHeroSkill.description: Adept skills are unlocked by acquiring {amount} other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.name: Expert Hero Skill
GLOBAL.ExpertHeroSkill.description: Expert skills are unlocked by acquiring {amount} other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.name: Master Hero Skill
GLOBAL.MasterHeroSkill.description: Master skills are unlocked by acquiring {amount} other skills in the same category.

GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.name: Hit Point
GLOBAL.HitPointConcept.description: Hit Points represent the amount of damage a Unit can sustain before it dies.Most units will take Casualty as their Hit Points drop.

GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.name: Line of Sight
GLOBAL.LineOfSightConcept.description: Most ranged attacks need Line of Sight to target an enemy.If obstacles or other Unit are between the attacker and the target, the target becomes Obscured, reducing Accuracy.Units adjacent to the attacker do not cause a target to be Obscured.

GLOBAL.MagicConcept.name: Magic
GLOBAL.MagicConcept.description:
Magic Attacks are attacks performed with magical implements such as orbs and staves.

Many of the special attacks that creatures have, such as dragon's breath, are also considered Magic attacks.

Magic attacks are resisted by Resistance.

GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.name: Melee
GLOBAL.MeleeConcept.description:
Melee attacks are short ranged attacks performed with weapons such as swords, spears, claws and teeth.

They mostly do Physical Damage and are resisted by Defense.

GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.name: Hero Mount
GLOBAL.HeroMountConcept.description:
Mounts can be equipped by P R O P E R T I E S. H E R O in the relevant slot.
They generally grant P R O P E R T I E S. F A S T_ M O V E M E N T and a small increase in Hit Point.
Certain powerful weapons cannot be wielded while mounted.
The mount that the P R O P E R T I E S. H E R O starts with depends on their race and any form traits that race may have.

GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.name: Movement
GLOBAL.MovementAbilityConcept.description:
An ability that moves the unit using it to another location.

Cannot be used by units that are P R O P E R T I E S. I M M O B I L I Z E D.
Cannot be used when on water unless also a Teleport Ability.

GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.name: Move Point
GLOBAL.MovePointConcept.description: Move Points represent how far a unit can move within a Turn on the World Map.Normal terrain costs {amount1} Move Points to traverse.Sometimes the Move Point cost of terrain can be reduced, such as when moving through your Domain, but it can never be reduced below {amount2} Move Points.In Combat Move Points are not used, Combat Speed is used instead.

GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.name: Negative Status Effect
GLOBAL.NegativeStatusEffectConcept.description:
A negative status effect is a temporary condition that weakens a unit in some way. They are often applied by <<Debuff Spell>> and Debuff abilities.

Examples include:P R O P E R T I E S. S U N D E R E D_ R E S I S T A N C EP R O P E R T I E S. P O I S O N E DP R O P E R T I E S. D O M I N A T E DP R O P E R T I E S. D E C A Y I N G

All cultures have a unit ability or spell that can remove negative status effects.

Additionally, some negative status effects have counters—for example, P R O P E R T I E S. P O I S O N E D can be removed by applying P R O P E R T I E S. R E G E N E R A T I O N.

GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.name: Can't be refreshed
GLOBAL.NoRefreshConcept.description: Abilities marked with "Can't be refreshed" cannot have their cooldowns and "once per battle" status reset in battle by special abilities such as P R O P E R T I E S. W E A V E R.

GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.name: Obscured
GLOBAL.ObscuredConcept.description: When a target is Obscured, it becomes {chance}% harder to hit with ranged attacks.

GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.name: Opportunity Attack
GLOBAL.OpportunityAttackConcept.description: Opportunity Attacks are a special type of Retaliation that are triggered when an enemy unit leaves the Zone Of Control.

GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.name: Positive Status Effect
GLOBAL.PositiveStatusEffectConcept.description:
A positive status effect is a temporary condition that strengthens a unit in some way. They are often applied by Buff Spell and Support abilities.

Examples include:P R O P E R T I E S. B O L S T E R E D_ R E S I S T A N C EP R O P E R T I E S. R E G E N E R A T I O NP R O P E R T I E S. H A S T E N E DP R O P E R T I E S. S T E A D F A S T

Certain rare unit abilities and spells can remove positive status effects.

Additionally, some positive status effects have counters—for example, P R O P E R T I E S. R E G E N E R A T I O N can be removed by applying P R O P E R T I E S. P O I S O N E D.

GLOBAL.RangeConcept.name: Range
GLOBAL.RangeConcept.description:
Range refers to the maximum number of hexes away from a unit that an ability can target.
Using attacks on a target at maximum range will often incur an Accuracy penalty.

GLOBAL.RangedConcept.name: Missile
GLOBAL.RangedConcept.description:
Missile attacks are medium to long ranged attacks performed with weapons such as bows or throwing knives.

They mostly do Physical Damage and are resisted by Defense.

GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.name: Resistance
GLOBAL.ResistanceConcept.description: Resistance reduces damage from Magic attacks and Combat Spell.

GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.name: Retaliation Attack
GLOBAL.RetaliationConcept.description: A Retaliation Attack is an attack triggered by another Unit's attacks or movementMelee units can Retaliate once per Turn (by default).Attacking an enemy unit within the Zone Of Control triggers a Retaliation.An enemy unit moving out of the Zone Of Control triggers an Opportunity Attack.

GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.name: Retreating
GLOBAL.RetreatingConcept.description: When a Unit moves onto a Retreat Point during Combat, they will immediately exit the battle. Nearby friendly units will lose morale .The unit will lose Move Points after battle.Retreating your last unit will cause you to lose the battle.If you lose the battle, the unit will either die, or scatter and reappear at one of your cities after a few turns.

GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.name: Status Resistance
GLOBAL.StatusResistanceConcept.description: Status Resistance reduces the chance that a unit will be affected by Negative Status Effect.

GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.name: Summoning
GLOBAL.SummoningAbilityConcept.description: An ability that summons a unit during battle.

GLOBAL.SupportConcept.name: Support
GLOBAL.SupportConcept.description: An ability that heals or applies Positive Status Effect to friendly units.

GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.name: Teleport
GLOBAL.TeleportAbilityConcept.description: An ability that instantly moves this unit to another location using magic.

GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.name: Temporary Hit Point
GLOBAL.TemporaryHitPointConcept.description: Temporary Hit Points are given to a Unit when it is healed in Combat.When a Unit takes damage, Temporary Hit Points are lost first.When combat ends, all Temporary Hit Points are removed.

GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.name: Morale
GLOBAL.UnitMoraleConcept.description:
Unit Morale represents willingness to battle.
High Morale increases Critical Hit Chance.Low Morale increases Fumble chance in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map.Very Low Morale further increases Fumble chance and can lead to Routing Unit in battle and Desertion chance on the World Map .

Morale States:High MoraleNeutral MoraleLow Morale.Very Low MoraleRouting

GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.name: Unit tier
GLOBAL.UnitTierConcept.description: Unit Tier represents its relative strength in Combat.Higher tier Unit have a higher per turn Unit Upkeep.Tier 3+ Units gain Status Resistance which increases for higher Tiers.Unit Tiers range from 1 to 5.Hero are treated as Tier 5 for relevant skills and abilities.

GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.name: World Map Regeneration
GLOBAL.WorldMapRegeneration.description:
Units recover a certain number of Hit Point each Turn when not in combat.

The amount of hit points regained is higher when the unit is in your Domain near one of your City or Outpost. Being in enemy domain or in the territory of a Infestation reduces regeneration.

World Map Regeneration can also be increased by certain Hero Skills and Empire Skill.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.name: Bounty
GLOBAL.CallToArmsConcept.description:
Bounties are Leader created quests that can be offered to other Rulers in exchange for a reward. Other non-hostile Rulers may choose to accept the bounty. The Ruler that completes the objective first will receive the reward and complete the bounty.

Rulers receive {Duration}Turn to complete the bounty. If the time runs out before the objective is completed, then they fail the bounty.

The bounty cannot be canceled while any Ruler is attempting it after the turn in which it was created. If the bounty fails during this time, it will return {FailurePercentage}% of the reward.

In order to create a bounty and have other Rulers accept it, specific requirements must be met.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.name: Bounty Requirements
GLOBAL.CallToArmsRequirementsConcept.description:
In order to create a Call To Arms, you must be at War with another Leader or Independent City. Possible bounty targets are:CityOutpost Bound Ancient Wonder Beacons of UnityOccupied Seals

A Call To Arms Viability is determined for each other ruler which determines whether they can accept your bounty or not. Rulers may accept up to {MaxBounties} Call To Arms from another ruler at any time.

GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.name: Call to War
GLOBAL.CallToWarConcept.description:
Leader may call each other into War with a Ruler who they themselves are already at war with.

The Rulers must share at least a Mutual Consulate to send a call to war. The receiving Ruler may choose to accept or decline the call. Accepting gives them a Casus Belli bonus, whereas declining will result in considerable relations penalties.

GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.name: Grievance
GLOBAL.CasusBelliConcept.description:
Grievances determine your War Justification against other Leader. They are your reason for going to war.

Obtained primarily by:Seeing a trespasser.Having another Ruler build on a Province you've claimed. Fabricating a Grievance.Being attacked.

Grievances can be exchanged for Resource with the Ruler they're held against.

GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.name: Rival Justification
GLOBAL.RivalJustificationConcept.description:
Rival justification is a one-sided War Justification that allows you to ignore the opponent's Casus Belli points up to the same amount as your Rival Justification when declaring War on them.
The opposing Leader is not affected by your Rival Justification when they declare war on you, nor are you affected by their Rival Justification.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.name: War Justification
GLOBAL.WarJustificationConcept.description:
War Justification is the balance of Casus Belli between two Leader and is used to determine the impact of declaring War.

When starting a War:Alignment may be affected.Imperium income may be affected.Non-allied rulers can receive Casus Belli.Empire Relation with other Rulers as well as relations with (Vassal)Cities may be affected.

The following War Justification levels can be reached:War Justification Lvl3 ({LVL3Min}+)War Justification Lvl2 ({LVL2Max} to {LVL2Min})War Justification Lvl1 ({LVL1Max} to {LVL1Min})War Justification Lvl0 ({LVL0Min})War Justification Lvl N1 ({LVL-1Max} to {LVL-1Min})War Justification Lvl N2 ({LVL-2Max} to {LVL-2Min})War Justification Lvl N3 ({LVL-3Min})

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.name: None
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl0Concept.description:
With no War Justification (0), declaring War becomes more damaging to your Empire.

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your {ResourcePenalty} income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.name: Minor
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl1Concept.description:
Having only minor War Justification ({Max} to {Min}), means that declaring War is justified but still frowned upon by other Leader.

Wars are still considered an evil act and your Empire Relation with other Rulers will suffer a penalty.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.name: Moderate
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl2Concept.description: With Moderate War Justification ({Max} to {Min}), declaring War is now supported by your Vassal Cities as they gain a Relations bonus, and your {ResourceBonus} income increases by {ResourceBonusValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.name: Major
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvl3Concept.description: With Major War Justification ({Max}+), declaring War is fully justified. Your Vassal Cities gain a Relations bonus, and your {ResourceBonus} income increases by {ResourceBonusValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.name: Unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN1Concept.description:
With negative War Justification ({Max} to {Min}), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your {ResourcePenalty} income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.name: Very unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN2Concept.description:
With negative War Justification ({Max} to {Min}), declaring War becomes even more damaging to your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively and, impact your {ResourcePenalty} income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.name: Completely unjust
GLOBAL.WarJustificationLvlN3Concept.description:
With completely negative War Justification ({Min}), declaring War can severely damage your Empire!

Unjustified wars are considered an evil act, affect all of your relations negatively, and impact your {ResourcePenalty} income by {ResourcePenaltyValue} while the war lasts.

GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.name: Fabricated Grievance
GLOBAL.FabricatedCasusBelliConcept.description:
A fabricated Casus Belli is a Grievance about an event that did not actually happen but can still be used as a cause for War.

Leader can only have one fabricated grievance against another Ruler and can use these to declare War or Denounce them. Fabricated Grievances can be sold to the opposing Ruler but cannot be forgiven.

Grievances can be fabricated through Pronouncements.

GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.name: Peace
GLOBAL.DSNeutralConcept.description: Peace is the default state of relations. Better terms are achieved through Negotiation, or War can be declared.

GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.name: Declaration of Friendship
GLOBAL.DeclFriendshipConcept.description:
Declare your Friendship with another Leader publicly.

A modifier that slowly increases towards {RelationValue} will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Casus Belli gained against that Ruler will be reduced by {Reduction}%. When two Rulers declare Friendship with each other, each active diplomatic treaty they have increases the maximum relations bonus by {RelationBonus}, up to {MaxRelationBonus} in total.

Maintaining a declaration costs {cost} upkeep per Turn, which increases by {costScale} for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncements.

GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.name: Declaration of Rivalry
GLOBAL.DeclRivalryConcept.description:
Declare a Rivalry with another Leader publicly.

A modifier that slowly decreases towards {RelationValue} will be added to your relations with the Ruler. Any Casus Belli gained against that Ruler will be increased by {Increase}%. However, making treaties becomes impossible and any existing treaties will be broken.

Additionally a rising Rival Justification modifier will be gained, which increases by {casusbellibonusperturn} per Turn up to {casusbellibonusmax}.

Maintaining a declaration costs {cost} upkeep per Turn, which increases by {costScale} for each additional declaration.

Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncements.

GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.name: Pact of Cooperation
GLOBAL.PactOfCooperationConcept.description: The Independent City opens its borders.A Trade Route can be established to this city from one of your own.Magic Material can be bought.

GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.name: Pact of Integration
GLOBAL.PactOfIntegrationConcept.description: City ownership is given to the Empire forging this pact.Ceases to exist as a diplomatic entity.The Free City Lord can be recruited as a Hero of the Empire forging this pact.Any Diplomatic Token will be released.

GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.name: Pact of Loyalty
GLOBAL.PactOfLoyaltyConcept.description: The Independent City shares its vision.The Independent City allows building on claimed provinces.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.Will reinforce in Combat against Marauder and Leader the Independent City is at Independent City War with.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.name: Pact of Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageConcept.description: The Independent City shares part of its Mana and Gold income as tribute.Magic Material they control are shared with their overlord.Other Empire may no longer negotiate better Pv E Dipl State with the Independent City.TheIndependent City will join its overlord in any War they are fighting, can assist in combat, and can be given directives in War Coordination.Switches to the Vassalage Phase, during which further House Influence can be earned to improve the benefits of vassalage. Eventually the Independent City may be integrated into the empire of its overlord.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.name: Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-1Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.War Coordination is disabled and no new armies will be sent out.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.name: Minor Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-2Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.name: Denying Tributary
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl-3Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares none of its Magic Material.Contributes nothing to the Rally of the Lieges.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.name: Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl0Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.War Coordination becomes available.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.name: Bonded Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl1Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.name: Flourishing Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl2Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.City can be integrated .

GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.name: Supreme Vassalage
GLOBAL.PactOfVassalageLvl3Concept.description: Trade Route with this Independent City provide {incomePercentage}% of its income.Shares all of its Magic Material.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.City can be integrated .

GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.name: Allegiance
GLOBAL.HouseInfluenceConcept.description:
Allegiance represents the commitment of a Independent City to an Empire.

Allegiance is primarily gained by giving a Diplomatic Token to the Free City Lord which starts Negotiation. Increasing allegiance will result in better Pv E Dipl State with the city, eventually leading to a Pact Of Vassalage and Pact Of Integration.

GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.name: Threat Level
GLOBAL.AIPressureConcept.description:
The threat level represents how threatened other Leader feel.

This level is influenced by many factors that look at how well each Ruler is doing: for example if they have large Army, many City, or are supported by many allies.

The threat level is expressed as a relations modifier.

GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.name: Pronouncement
GLOBAL.PronouncementsConcept.description: A statement or declaration that Leader can make towards other Rulers to enhance their Relations. Includes fabricating Casus Belli, making declarations, Calling Rulers to War and more.

GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.name: Negotiation Phase
GLOBAL.NegotiationPhaseConcept.description:
During the negotiation phase, all Empire may negotiate with a Independent City for higher House Influence and better diplomatic states. Once an Empire has secured enough House Influence for a Pact Of Vassalage, this competition ends and the \"winning\" Empire enters the Vassalage Phase.

These are the Pv E Dipl State of the Negotiation Phase:Independent City WarIndependent City NeutralPact Of CooperationPact Of LoyaltyPact Of Vassalage

GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.name: Vassalage Phase
GLOBAL.VassalagePhaseConcept.description:
During the vassalage phase, only the overlord Empire may negotiate with a Independent City. Other Empire can only declare Independent City War on the Independent City by declaring war on the Free City overlord.

These are the Pv E Dipl State of the Vassalage Phase:Pact Of Vassalage Lvl-3Pact Of Vassalage Lvl-2Pact Of Vassalage Lvl-1Pact Of Vassalage Lvl0Pact Of Vassalage Lvl1Pact Of Vassalage Lvl2Pact Of Vassalage Lvl3

Once Pact Of Vassalage Lvl2 is reached, the Pact Of Integration becomes available, allowing an Empire to fully absorb the Independent City.

GLOBAL.TruceConcept.name: Truce
GLOBAL.TruceConcept.description: Both Leader vow not to attack each other while the truce lasts. War may still be declared, but counts as an evil act.

GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.name: Trespassing
GLOBAL.TrespassingConcept.description:
Armies are considered to be trespassing when they are seen moving through the Province of another Leader or Independent City without having an open borders agreement.

Trespassing will give other Rulers a Casus Belli and damages the relation with free cities.

GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.name: Alliances
GLOBAL.PTDAlliancesConcept.description: The Ruler is less inclined toward hostile actions, is keen to act more in favor of good relations with other Rulers and cities and will not break their Alliances.

GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.name: Covert
GLOBAL.PTDCovertConcept.description: The Ruler is prone to making pronouncements and Calls to War more often, but is less eager to answer a call to war.

GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.name: Gaining vassals
GLOBAL.PTDGainVassalsConcept.description: The Ruler favors gaining both cities and Rulers as vassals, but will not submit to becoming a vassal themselves.

GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.name: Hard bargains
GLOBAL.PTDGreedyConcept.description: The Ruler likes to carry on Trade but tends to place more value on their own side of the deal. Other Rulers may have to sweeten their offers to make a deal happen.

GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.name: Isolation
GLOBAL.PTDIsolationConcept.description: The Ruler does not easily want to commit to relations and is reluctant to answer Calls to War.

GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTDNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler engages in all forms of diplomacy to an equal degree as opportunities arise.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.name: Never breaks treaties
GLOBAL.PTDNeverBreakTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler is committed to the Treaty they have with other Rulers and will always try to prevent them from being broken.

GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.name: Never Surrender
GLOBAL.PTDNeverSurrenderConcept.description: The Ruler will not submit to becoming another Ruler's vassal. During War, they will not make peace of their own accord. They are more eager to call allies to war and will also more readily answer a Call To War.

GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.name: Wary of Treaties
GLOBAL.PTDNoTreatiesConcept.description: In general, the Ruler is not interested in having Treaty with other Rulers, making such trades more costly for the opposing side. They are reluctant to call another Ruler to war and to answer any incoming Calls to War.

GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.name: Trading
GLOBAL.PTDTradingConcept.description: The Ruler is keen on making Trade offers fairly often.

GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.name: Favors treaties
GLOBAL.PTDTreatiesConcept.description: The Ruler prefers forming Treaty with other Rulers and will not break any treaties or Alliances they have.

GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.name: Vassalize the Strong
GLOBAL.PTDVassalizeToStrongConcept.description: The Ruler is tempted to make vassals of other strong Rulers.

GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.name: Driven by War
GLOBAL.PTDWarDrivenConcept.description: The Ruler is easily provoked into going to War, even over minor Casus Belli. They will not sell or forgive any of their grievances and are more eager to send and answer a Call To War.

GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.name: War must be justified
GLOBAL.PTDWarJustifiedConcept.description: The Ruler will not go to War over minor Casus Belli and will want to justify their war.

GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.name: Dislike
GLOBAL.PersonalityPreferenceConcept.description: Dislikes are part of how an AI Ruler perceives other Rulers and determines which Actions or statuses of another Ruler they will dislike. Relations with Rulers that trigger these dislikes will incur a relation penalty.

GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.name: Strategy
GLOBAL.PersonalityStrategyConcept.description: A Ruler's Strategy determines how they will act in terms of their Economy, Research, and Military, but also on a Diplomatic Level.

GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.name: Expansion
GLOBAL.PTSExpansionConcept.description: The Ruler favors expanding their empire by building and absorbing cities. They focus on improving their cities and defending them.

GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.name: Exploitation
GLOBAL.PTSExploitationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploiting all forms of resources near them and will hunt down Pickup, marauders and cities with their army. Captured cities will be migrated into their own population.

GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.name: Exploration
GLOBAL.PTSExplorationConcept.description: The Ruler favors exploring the map, seeking out potential resources such as Pickup and Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.name: Extermination
GLOBAL.PTSExterminationConcept.description: The Ruler favors capturing resources using large armies rather than building them themselves and will raze other Rulers' cities that they have occupied.

GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.name: Neutral
GLOBAL.PTSNeutralConcept.description: The Ruler has no specific agenda or focus and acts more on the opportunities that present themselves.

GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.name: Pure Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral01Concept.description: A knowledgeable Ruler who believes in mind over matter.

GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.name: Strategist Warlord
GLOBAL.PTAstral02Concept.description: An ambitious Ruler who values strategy and magical prowess.

GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.name: Erudite Sage
GLOBAL.PTAstral03Concept.description: A peaceful Ruler who values wisdom and learning.

GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.name: Militant Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos01Concept.description: A power-hungry Ruler who believes that might makes right.

GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.name: Revolutionary Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTChaos02Concept.description: A rebellious Ruler who values both freedom and alliances.

GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.name: Demonic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTChaos03Concept.description: A bloodthirsty Ruler who prefers treachery to weakness.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.name: Competitive Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium01Concept.description: A coin-savvy Ruler who is willing to trade... for the right price.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.name: Solitary Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTMaterium02Concept.description: An isolated Ruler who believes in a strong defensive force.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.name: Artisan Merchant
GLOBAL.PTMaterium03Concept.description: An expressive creator who values both matter and mind.

GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.name: Economic Warlord
GLOBAL.PTMaterium04Concept.description: A greedy Ruler who will stop at nothing to achieve economic goals.

GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.name: Persevering Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTNature01Concept.description: A peace-keeping Ruler who believes in good relations.

GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.name: Harmonious Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature02Concept.description: A forgiving Ruler who values alliances and exploration.

GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.name: Protective Sage
GLOBAL.PTNature03Concept.description: A vigilant Ruler who prefers vassalization and magic.

GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.name: Chivalrous Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder01Concept.description: An honorable Ruler who believes in justice and peace.

GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.name: Authoritarian Diplomat
GLOBAL.PTOrder02Concept.description: A strict Ruler who believes in high civic order.

GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.name: Imperial Warlord
GLOBAL.PTOrder03Concept.description: An imperialistic Ruler who favors stability through subjugation.

GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.name: Fanatic Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTOrder04Concept.description: A secluded Ruler who values purity of mind and empire.

GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.name: Deceptive Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow01Concept.description: A cunning Ruler who values power and treachery.

GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.name: Reserved Isolationist
GLOBAL.PTShadow02Concept.description: An individualistic Ruler who prefers peaceful co-existence.

GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.name: Sinister Spy
GLOBAL.PTShadow03Concept.description: A self-centered Ruler who prefers to deal with the weak.

GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.name: Province-Claiming Pact
GLOBAL.AllowClaimedSectorsConcept.description: Both Leader are allowed to build on each other's claimed Province without triggering Casus Belli.

GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.name: Wizard's Bond
GLOBAL.MutualConsulateConcept.description:
Both Leader agree to a wizard's bond to improve Empire Relation and access new Treaty and Diplomatic States.

Effects:[bulletList]The Throne City of each Ruler will be revealed.Rulers can call each other to war.[/bulletList]

Leads to:Defensive PactOpen BordersAllow Claimed SectorsTeleporter PactTrade Agreement

GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.name: Defensive Pact
GLOBAL.DefensivePactConcept.description:
A Diplomatic State in which the Leader vow to come to each other's aid in defensive wars.

When war is declared on either Ruler, they will automatically send a Call To War to the other, asking them to aid them in the war. Answering this call to war will give the Ruler additional Casus Belli to use directly. Rulers may still refuse to accept this call but will break the defensive pact if they do.

Leads to:D S AllianceShare Vision

GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.name: Free Trade Agreement
GLOBAL.TradeAgreementConcept.description: Both Leader allow each other to establish Trade Route between each other's City.

GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.name: Open Borders
GLOBAL.OpenBordersConcept.description: Both Leader open their borders to each other. This allows Army to move through Province of the opposing Ruler without trespassing.

GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.name: return captured heroes
GLOBAL.ReturnCapturedHeroesConcept.description:
When captured Hero are returned to their original owner, they will become available for recruitment (for free). Heroes in the Crypt will be returned to the crypt of the original owner instead.

When reaching an D S Alliance, Leader will automatically return their captured heroes to the other ruler.

GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.name: Share Vision
GLOBAL.ShareVisionConcept.description: Both Leader share their Vision with each other and will reveal explored areas to each other.

GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.name: Teleporter Pact
GLOBAL.TeleporterPactConcept.description: Both Leader allow each other to teleport to and from their Teleporter.

GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.name: Hero Class: Battlesaint
GLOBAL.HeroClassBattlesaint.description: Compatible weapons:Great WeaponOne Handed WeaponShieldFist WeaponPolearm WeaponMagic Staff WeaponMagic Orb WeaponSkirmishing Weapon

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.name: Monument
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of Province Improvement available to the Architect and built using Wonder Stone.
Monuments grant their owner P R O P E R T I E S. A F F I N I T Y_ I N C A R N A T E_ U N I T_ P R O P E R T Y, on higher tiers they grant additional Affinity and economic effects to their owner.

GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.name: Monument
GLOBAL.ArchitectMonumentShortConcept.description:
Monuments are a unique type of Province Improvement available to the Architect and built using Wonder Stone.
Monuments cannot be hurried in the city screen, and cannot have their cost reduced.

GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.name: Blessed
GLOBAL.BlessedTerrainConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A serene aura can be felt in the surrounding terrain. City annexing this province gain {citystability} City Stability.

GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.name: Dragon Lord
GLOBAL.DragonLordConcept.description: Dragon Lords have access to unique combat Hero Skills.Dragon Lords gain powerful transformation Hero Dedication based on empire Affinity.Gain extra Gold through their Dragon Hoard.Dragon Lords are P R O P E R T I E S. H E R O T R A I T_ G O V E R N A N C E_ D R A G O N_ G O V E R N O R.Dragon Lords have a {amount} Gold Unit Upkeep and cannot equip most Hero Items.

GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.name: Beacon of Light
GLOBAL.BeaconOfLightConcept.description: An Army can build a Sanctuary Outpost on a Province. Shielding units from P R O P E R T I E S. S H A D O W_ S I C K N E S S and allowing annexation of nearby Province.

GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.name: Sanctuary Outpost
GLOBAL.SanctuaryOutpostConcept.description: A type of Outpost that can only be built in a Province in the Umbral Abyss with a Beacon Of Light.Friendly Unit inside the Domain of a Sanctuary Outpost are immune to P R O P E R T I E S. S H A D O W_ S I C K N E S S.City cannot be founded in Sanctuary Outposts.Once built, can be upgraded to annex {amount} additional provinces.Grants {gold} Gold, {mana} Mana, and {knowledge} Knowledge.

GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.name: Eldritch Pact
GLOBAL.EldritchPactConcept.description: The Dwelling shares its income and Magic Material.The Dwelling shares its vision.The Dwelling allows building on claimed provinces.Contributes {commandPoints} to the Request Military Aid.Will reinforce in Combat against Marauder and Leader the Dwelling is at Independent City War with.Allows the purchasing of special Spell and other bonuses to benefit from Gloom Terrain via Cooperation.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.name: Truce
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingTruce.description:
The Umbral Dwelling tolerates you.

Counts as Independent City Neutral state.

Umbral Dwellings do not care about Trespassing or Province Claims.

You cannot assign a Diplomatic Token to Umbral Dwellings. Instead, making more sacrifices will let you reach an Eldritch Pact.

GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.UmbralDwellingWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a Dwelling means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Dwellings will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

When an Umbral Dwelling conquers another City. It will destroy it and create an Umbral Nest Infestation.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.name: Umbral Abyss
GLOBAL.UmbralAbyssConcept.description: Units in this layer suffer P R O P E R T I E S. S H A D O W_ S I C K N E S S.Outpost and City can't be built in this layer.Terraforming Spell can't be used in this layer.

GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.name: Gloom Tear
GLOBAL.GloomTearConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A wound in reality seeping with eldritch power. Makes this province count as having Gloom Terrain.

GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.name: Declaration of Debt
GLOBAL.DeclSupremacyConcept.description: Utilize Favors to keep another Leader at bay:A modifier that slowly increases towards {RelationValue} will be added to your relations with the Ruler. While the Declaration lasts, the affected player will not have any grudge affecting the relation for any of their Casus Belli towards you.Maintaining a declaration costs {cost} upkeep per Turn, which increases by {costScale} for each additional declaration.Declarations can be made and ended through Pronouncements.

GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.name: Gaining War Spoils
GLOBAL.GainingWarspoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are gained through:

Killing Unit belonging to Independent City, Dwelling, or Empire.Unit Tier I units grant {T1Reward}.Unit Tier II units grant {T2Reward}.Unit Tier III units grant {T3Reward} .Unit Tier IV units grant {T4Reward}.Unit Tier V units grant {T5Reward}.Hero grant {HeroReward} per level.

Pillaging Provinces grants +{PillageReward}.

GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.name: Favors
GLOBAL.FavorsConcept.description:
A unique resource used by the Federated Reaver subculture.
Favors are used to influence Free Cities, coordinate Vassals, and recruit from Request Military Aid.

Favors are gained by defeating Marauder, destroying Infestation, and maintaining Pact Of Vassalage Lvl3 with Independent City.

GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.name: War Spoils
GLOBAL.WarSpoilsConcept.description:
War Spoils are a unique resource gathered by Imperial Reaver through conquest and battle with Empire, Dwelling, and Independent City as well as pillaging. GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.name: Shop Structure
GLOBAL.ShopStructureConcept.description:
Shops are Location that can appear randomly in your domain as you play. In return for Gold or Mana, they can give you access to many unique bonuses—such as new mounts and skills for your heroes, or information on the whereabouts of your foes.

You can use any shop within your domain immediately, if the shop is outside your domain you will need to move an Army onto it to unlock it. Once unlocked, you can access the shop without your army being present.

You may choose to attack the shop if you wish—you will gain valuable rewards if you win, but don't expect your custom to be welcome if you do not!

GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.name: Landmark
GLOBAL.LandmarkConcept.description:
Landmarks are a type of location the size of an entire region. Landmarks themselves cannot be annexed or claimed. Instead, landmarks grant effects to all adjacent Province.

If a City has a certain amount of provinces in their domain adjacent to one Landmark, they gain an additional bonus effect depending on the type of landmark.

Landmarks count as Handcrafted Region, meaning they can be disabled with the Untouched Realm Trait.

GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.name: Favored Terrain
GLOBAL.FavoredTerrainConcept.description: The Primal culture gains various bonuses from its favored terrain:Their Primal Animal gains P R O P E R T I E S. F R E N Z Y in their favored terrain.Extra income is earned from provinces in favored terrain.The Spirit Temple structure can alter provinces into favored terrain.

GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.name: Cataclysm Victory
GLOBAL.CataclysmVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve the Cataclysm Victory, explore the Echoes of the Fracturing searching for the Artifact of the Unmakers Lore within Fated Regions.

Acquire 3 Artifact to claim victory.

GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.name: Loot
GLOBAL.ScavengerLootConcept.description:
Can be picked up by any unit with the P R O P E R T I E S. S C A V E N G E R property by moving onto this hex.
On pickup, the unit:Gains P R O P E R T I E S. L O O T E D_ P O W E R.Heals for +{HealBonus} Hit Point.

GLOBAL.NomadConcept.name: Nomad
GLOBAL.NomadConcept.description: Mobile units that focus on maneuvering and flanking.Nomad Cities are able to pack up into a Nomad Settler and relocate.Nodes in domain of their Cities are Overharvested over time, exhausting the Nodes to gain Essence in that city.Nomad Cities require {PercentageDecrease}% more Food to gain Population.

GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.name: Aggressive Expansion
GLOBAL.AggressiveExpansionConcept.description:
Aggressive Expansion rewards Province Annexation of provinces belonging to other factions.

Annexing a hostile province to a city grants a one time reward of Structure Production, Unit Production, and Gold.

These rewards scale with the population of the city the province was taken from.

GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.name: Essence
GLOBAL.EssenceConcept.description:
Essences are magical objects tied to a city, granting income and other bonuses. They are obtained by Overharvesting Node with a Nomad City.
The type of income an essence gives depends on the node they come from.Essences from Magic Material grant that material to the city's owner.If a city carrying Magic Material essences is razed, those Magic Material will appear as nodes nearby.

Nomads of the Scavenger tradition also gain unique Essences with Wonder Scavenging.

GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.name: Overharvesting
GLOBAL.OverharvestingConcept.description:
Nomad City Overharvest Node in their Domain. This process takes several turns but may be accelerated using Imperium proportionate to the time remaining on that particular Node.

Once Overharvested:The City gains an Essence corresponding to that Node.The Node is destroyed, becoming a Ruined Node.

GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.name: Nomad City Barge
GLOBAL.NomadSettlerConcept.description:
Nomad City may pack up into a City Barge, a unit that can move around on the World Map.

This unit:Can Unpack into a Nomad City, able to immediately claim Province as its Population allows.Can place any Special Improvement it had before being packed up for free.Does not participate in Combat and is defeated immediately if not defended by other friendly units.Combat against this unit will take place on the Siege city defense map with all City Defense structures present.

If this unit is defeated in combat, it may be captured by the victor or immediately P R O P E R T I E S. C O M B A T P R O P E R T Y_ R A Z E D.

GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.name: Wonder Scavenging
GLOBAL.WonderScavengingConcept.description:
When an Ancient Wonder is annexed to a City belonging to Nomad Scavengers, it will be Overharvested, granting the city a unique Essence.

Overharvesting Ancient Wonders:Does not destroy the Ancient Wonder.Can only be done once per Ancient Wonder.

The type of Essence gained is based on the Improvement type and Tier of the Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.name: Roaming City Income
GLOBAL.RoamingCityConcept.description: Roaming City Income is the amount of Resource a Nomad Settler generates each Turn while packed up.

GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.name: Sandstorm
GLOBAL.SandstormConcept.description:
Units passing through or ending their turn on this hex:Have a base {chance}% chance of becoming P R O P E R T I E S. B L I N D E D for {amount} Turn.Become P R O P E R T I E S. S L O W E D for {amount} Turn.
Units with P R O P E R T I E S. S A N D_ W A L K are immune to this effect.

GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.name: Backfire Tailwinds
GLOBAL.BackfireTailwindsConcept.description: When a healing or buffing spell Backfires for this player, it always triggers a positive effect.When a damaging or debuffing spell Backfires for this player, it always triggers a negative effect for the enemy.

GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.name: Shrouded Isle
GLOBAL.ShroudedIsleConcept.description:
Ancient gates are scattered throughout the realm. They lead to floating isles in a mysterious dimension where powerful Godir Lore hid away their most prized secrets.
A new Shrouded map layer is added to the realm.This layer contains Shrouded Isle and Breached Isle.Various portals can be found on the Surface and Underground which lead to these Isles.

GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.name: Breached Isle
GLOBAL.BreachedIsleConcept.description: A breached isle is a handcrafted region which:Is only accessible through a portal on Surface or Underground.These portals are accessible at the start and are not guarded.Contains a S T R U C T U R E S. B R E A C H E D_ A R C A N U M and various other valuable Location

GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.name: Blood Drain
GLOBAL.BloodDrainConcept.description: The blood draining abilities of a Vampire: P R O P E R T I E S. D R A I N I N G_ B I T E and P R O P E R T I E S. S I P H O N_ B L O O D.

GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.name: Crimson Court Magistrate
GLOBAL.CrimsonCourtMagistrateConcept.description: Gain {amount} Mana on successfully Pillaging a Province Improvement.Gain {amount2} Mana on successfully Razing a conquered City per Population and Province Improvement that hasn't been Pillaged.Gain {amount3} Mana on successfully Migrating a conquered City per Population. But the City loses additional Population afterward.Pv E Vassal grant {amount4} Mana income per Population.

GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.name: Sunless
GLOBAL.SunlessConcept.description:
A Province Feature

The absence of sunlight has spread thorny and dark flora dotted with crimson roses.
City annexing this Province suffer {stabilitypenalty} City Stability.Unit regenerate {regen} Hit Point per Turn in the World Map.Unit receive {percentage} less Temporary Hit Point when healed in Combat.Units and Cities that have P R O P E R T I E S. H E A R T L E S S or are of an empire led by a Vampire Lord are immune to these effects.

GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.name: Elder Vampire
GLOBAL.VampireLordConcept.description: An P R O P E R T I E S. U N D E A D unit with an aversion to light.Has access to S T R U C T U R E_ U P G R A D E S. L O R D_ C A S T L E_ F O U N D A T I O N which replaces the S T R U C T U R E_ U P G R A D E S. W I Z A R D_ T O W E R_ F O U N D A T I O N and grants the use of Thrall to cast powerful ritual Spell.Drains {amountXP}% of the combat Experience earned by Turned Vampire heroes.Faction is immune to Sunless terrain's penalties to City Stability and Unit Morale.Elder Vampires are P R O P E R T I E S. H E R O T R A I T_ G O V E R N A N C E_ V A M P I R E_ G O V E R N O R.Elder Vampires have a {amount3} Gold Unit Upkeep

GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.name: Devotion
GLOBAL.DevotionConcept.description:
Reflects how devoted to its oath your empire is based on its actions. Devotion influences:The strength of the P R O P E R T I E S. H A R M O N I Z E, P R O P E R T I E S. N O B I L I T Y and P R O P E R T I E S. W A R R I O R S_ S O U L culture unit abilities.City Stability in your cities.

Levels of Devotion:{Devo3Min} to {Devo3Max}: Devotion3{Devo2Min} to {Devo2Max}: Devotion2{Devo1Min} to {Devo1Max}: Devotion1{Devo0Min} to {Devo0Max}: Devotion0{Devo-1Min} to {Devo-1Max}: Devotion-1

GLOBAL.MistConcept.name: Mist
GLOBAL.MistConcept.description: Units that end their turn on this hex gain P R O P E R T I E S. C L I N G I N G_ M I S T.

GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.name: Cataclysm
GLOBAL.CataclysmConcept.description:
A Cataclysm can trigger due to the Devouring Winds. When it triggers:
All provinces that were marked are struck:If a structure is present in the center of the province, it is destroyed or Pillaged.A S T R U C T U R E S. F L E E T I N G_ F R A C T U R E D_ I N F E S T A T I O N is placed in the center of the province if able.The province is no longer marked.All Spell permanently gain +{percentage} chance of Backfiring.All Empire gain a Casus Belli against the Empire that triggered the Cataclysm.The Cataclysm Meter is reset and its level increases by 1.

GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.name: Fortification Damage
GLOBAL.FortificationDamageConcept.description:
Fortification Damage represents the speed at which a Siege progresses to breach the defenses of a City

Fortification Damage is subtracted from Fortification Health of the City during a Siege until it is reduced to 0.

Fortification Damage in a Siege comes from:A base value of {base}Siege Project the besieger is undertaking.Besieging Unit with P R O P E R T I E S. S I E G E_ B R E A K E R that are adjacent to the City.

GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.name: Fortification Health
GLOBAL.FortificationHealthConcept.description:
Fortification Health represents how long the duration of a Siege will be on a City. The greater the Fortification Health, the longer the Siege will take.

During a Siege, the besieger will try and reduce the City's Fortification Health to 0 by dealing Fortification Damage. Fortification Health cannot increase during a Siege.

City Defense Structure are the primary source of Fortification Health.

A City with Fortification Health still requires any Wall structure to be present before a siege is required.

GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.name: Alignment Agenda
GLOBAL.AlignmentAgendaConcept.description: The High Culture has an Alignment Agenda, which grants bonuses for the following alignment levels: Pure Good: {citystabilitybonus} City Stability in all City. Neutral: {foodbonus} Food and {productionbonus} Structure Production per City Stability level above Neutral in all City. Pure Evil: Unit start Combat in an P R O P E R T I E S. A W A K E N E D state.

GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.name: Alignment
GLOBAL.AlignmentConcept.description:
Determines how Independent City and other Empire see you. Affected by Leader traits and various actions.

Affects relations with Independent City and Empire with Neutral or better Alignment. In addition a Good Alignment (or better) will increase the chance of positive random events occurring, while an Evil Alignment (or worse) will make negative random events more likely.

High Culture has an Alignment Agenda.

Empire Relation for each Alignment level: {PureGoodMinValue} to {PureGoodMaxValue}: Pure Good: {PureGoodRelationValue} {VeryGoodMinValue} to {VeryGoodMaxValue}: Very Good: {VeryGoodRelationValue} {GoodMinValue} to {GoodMaxValue}: Good: {GoodRelationValue} {NeutralMaxValue} to {NeutralMinValue}: Neutral: No effects{EvilMaxValue} to {EvilMinValue}: Evil: {EvilRelationValue} {VeryEvilMaxValue} to {VeryEvilMinValue}: Very Evil: {VeryEvilRelationValue} {PureEvilMaxValue} to {PureEvilMinValue}: Pure Evil: {PureEvilRelationValue}

GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.name: Competitor
GLOBAL.CompetitorConcept.description:
Competitors are Leader that have at least negotiated a Pact Of Cooperation with a Free City and are actively negotiating with that City.

Competing Rulers will receive a Casus Belli against a Ruler that vassalizes their desired city.

GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.name: Dwelling
GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.description:
Dwellings are independent City that usually have unique ways to influence and offer unique benefits.

Like Independent City they:Have a Free City Lord.Have diplomatic standings with you that can be improved.Do not belong to an Empire.

Dwellings are not affected by Realm Traits or Spell that affect Free Cities.

GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.name: Empire Relations
GLOBAL.EmpireRelationConcept.description:
Represents the degree to which two Empire are on good terms with one another.

Good Empire Relations are required to negotiate a Mutual Consulate and Treaty. Eventually good relations can lead to an D S Alliance.

Bad Empire Relations increase the chance of War being declared.

Empire Relations can be improved by:High AlignmentPronouncementsGifts Trades

GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.name: Free City
GLOBAL.IndependentCityConcept.description:
Free Cities are City that do not belong to an Empire. They have a Free City Lord with whom it is possible to negotiate.

With a higher Pv E Dipl State, a Free City offers: Trading.Recruitment Points for the Request Military Aid.Shared Income.

When an Empire reaches the highest Pv E Dipl State with a Free City, the city may become part of that empire through a Pact Of Integration. Alternatively Independent City War may be declared to acquire the Free City through conquest.

GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.name: Free City Lord
GLOBAL.FreeCityLordConcept.description:
A Free City Lord or Lady is the designated ruler of a Independent City. They represent their Independent City Concept. Name in all diplomatic interactions with an Empire and fight for their city as Hero on the World Map.

When the Free City Lord dies (and their Free City has not been conquered or integrated) they will be replaced by their heir, who will become the new Free City Lord after {IntDuration} Turn. The free city will not be able to cast Combat Spell until this has happened.

GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.name: Diplomatic State
GLOBAL.PvEDiplStateConcept.description:
The diplomatic state with a Independent City is the formal expression of their House Influence. A newly met Independent City will be on neutral terms with an Empire (in some cases War is declared instantly). By sending their Free City Lord a Diplomatic Token, the House Influence of the Independent City with that Empire will improve over time.

Higher House Influence leads to better diplomatic states with more valuable benefits. This negotiation process is divided into the Negotiation Phase and the Vassalage Phase, which eventually leads to the Pact Of Integration.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.name: Relations
GLOBAL.IndependentCityRelationConcept.description: Relations with a Independent City represent their opinion of a Ruler. The relation value can affect the amount of House Influence gained during Negotiation and with very low relations the free city may also declare Independent City War when on the Independent City Neutral diplomatic state.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.name: Trade
GLOBAL.IndependentCityTradeConcept.description:
Independent City may be asked to focus on a particular resource by Leader that share at least a Pact Of Cooperation with the City.

They may also provide any Magic Material located in the domain of the city in exchange for payment.

A Free City will only agree to one active trade at a time, after the trade has expired a new trade can be made.

GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.IndependentCityWarConcept.description:
A state of War with a Independent City means that Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

During war, Free Cities will occasionally send armies to attack their enemies.

Wars end through defeat on either side or by negotiating peace.

GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.NegotiationsCollectedConcept.description: There are two different types of negotiations:Trade between Leader.Negotiation between Rulers and Independent City.

GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.NegotiationConcept.description:
Negotiations increase the House Influence of a Independent City leading to better Pv E Dipl State with an Empire.

Negotiations happen automatically when a Diplomatic Token is assigned or the city is vassalized.

GLOBAL.TradeConcept.name: Negotiation
GLOBAL.TradeConcept.description: Negotiations allow Rulers to exchange strategic resources, locations and contact information among other things, but it also allows them to manage their relations and establish new Treaty and diplomatic states.

GLOBAL.WarConcept.name: War
GLOBAL.WarConcept.description:
A state of War with an Empire or Independent City means their Army can engage in Combat and City can be attacked.

Wars end through defeat on either side or peacefully when:Two Empires negotiate a Truce.By negotiating Peace with a Independent City Concept. Name.

Defeat occurs when one side loses its Throne City and Leader.

GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.name: Research
GLOBAL.ResearchConcept.description: Research is where Knowledge is spent to unlock items from Tome.

GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.name: Enchantments and Single Shot Attacks
GLOBAL.EnchantingNonRepeatingConcept.description:
Damage and chance-based effects from Unit Enchantment and Hero Skills have increased potency on Single Shot attacks, like P R O P E R T I E S. B A S E_ M E L E E_ C H A R G E and P R O P E R T I E S. B A S E_ M A G I C_ B L A S T.

Usually flat damage values are doubled, and the chances of Negative Status Effect are increased by {standardDebuffIncrease}%

GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.name: Astral Boon
GLOBAL.AstralBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the Astral forces strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.name: Chaos Boon
GLOBAL.ChaosBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Chaos strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.name: Materium Boon
GLOBAL.MateriumBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Materium strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.name: Nature Boon
GLOBAL.NatureBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Nature strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.name: Order Boon
GLOBAL.OrderBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Order strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your cities.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.name: Shadow Boon
GLOBAL.ShadowBoonConcept.description:
Your communion with the forces of Shadow strengthens your rule, temporarily increasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Shadow Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.name: Affinity Check
GLOBAL.AffinityCheckConcept.description:
When the empire of a player has reached a high enough Affinity score, this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions the player Ruler or one of their heroes attempts to channel the respective Affinity to perform a challenging action.

Each Affinity check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the empire Affinity is lower than X.50% base chance to succeed when the empire Affinity is exactly X.This chance increases by {IntAffinityStepChance} for every Empire Affinity Point above X.

GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.name: Astral Crisis
GLOBAL.AstralCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the Astral forces weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Astral Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.name: Chaos Crisis
GLOBAL.ChaosCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Chaos weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Chaos Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.name: Materium Crisis
GLOBAL.MateriumCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Materium weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Materium Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.name: Nature Crisis
GLOBAL.NatureCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Nature weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Nature Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.name: Order Crisis
GLOBAL.OrderCrisisConcept.description:
Your struggle with the forces of Order weakens your rule, temporarily decreasing City Stability in all of your City.

The strength of this effect scales up with higher Order Empire Affinity.

GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.name: Battle Quest
GLOBAL.BattleQuestConcept.description: Battle Quests ask you to defeat an Army of Marauder Unit on the World Map. They may only be resolved through Combat and will fail when another non-ally Player defeats the quest army.

GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.name: Befriend City Quest
GLOBAL.BefriendCityQuestConcept.description: Befriend City Quests ask you to reach a higher diplomatic state with a Independent City. This can be achieved by giving that Free City a Diplomatic Token and improving their House Influence with you over time. If the Free City becomes vassalized or conquered by another Player, the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.name: Build Improvement Quest
GLOBAL.BuildImprovementQuestConcept.description: Build Improvement Quests ask you to construct a number of Province Improvement of a certain type. You can build a Province Improvement whenever one of your City grows new Population. When you dismantle a Province Improvement of the matching type this will subtract progress from the quest.

GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.name: Conquer City Quest
GLOBAL.ConquerCityQuestConcept.description: Conquer City quests ask you to conquer a Independent City. This requires you to declare war on that Free City and may involve a Siege if there are any City Defense Structure. If the Free City becomes conquered by another Player (even an ally) the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.name: Destroy Infestation Quest
GLOBAL.DestroyInfestationQuestConcept.description: Destroy Infestation quests ask you to destroy an Infestation on the World Map. Beware of the roaming Army inside the Infestation's Domain! If the Infestation is destroyed by another non-ally Player the quest will fail.

GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.name: Encounter Quest
GLOBAL.EncounterQuestConcept.description: Encounter Quests ask you to deal with an Army of Marauder Unit on the World Map. When engaging the quest army, there will be narrative choices that may alter Combat in your favor or even completely avoid it for a price.

GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.name: Magic Material Quest
GLOBAL.MagicMaterialQuestConcept.description: Magic Material Quests ask you to obtain a Magic Material. This can be either achieved by annexing a Province with a Magic Material Node in its Domain or by acquiring the Magic Material through a trade with a Independent City or Player.

GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.name: Primal Check
GLOBAL.PrimalCheckConcept.description:
When a monster ruler has reached a high enough Level, this can unlock special character actions in story events. Within those actions, the player ruler attempts to channel their primal powers to perform a challenging action.

Each Primal Check has a strength X, which determines how the option behaves:

The option is hidden as long as the Ruler Level is lower than X.50% base chance of success when the Ruler Level is exactly X.This chance increases by {IntLevelStepChance} for every Ruler Level above X.

GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.name: Expansion Victory
GLOBAL.ExpansionVictoryConcept.description:
To achieve an Expansion Victory, an Empire needs to control enough provinces to unlock the S T R U C T U R E_ U P G R A D E S. B E A C O N O F U N I T Y. After building three beacons in different cities, you can light the Beacons, during which hostile armies are spawned in an attempt to destroy them. If you can defend the Beacons for {amount} Turn, you will be victorious.

Provinces count when they belong to your City directly, or when they belong to your Independent City with at least a Pact Of Vassalage Lvl1.

GLOBAL.ResourceConcept.name: Resource
GLOBAL.ResourceConcept.description: Resources are used to pay for various actions and are primarily obtained in City. Some resources can only be spent in the city itself, whereas other resources can be used everywhere.

GLOBAL.VisitSiteConcept.name: Visit Site
GLOBAL.VisitSiteConcept.description:
Visit Sites are Location that grant benefits by visiting them with an Army. Unlike most Locations, they are not protected by Marauder.
Some Visit Sites will show a button to press when having them selected and occupied by one of your Armies in order to activate the benefits. They will then grant buffs to the Army currently occupying the Visit Site.

GLOBAL.AffinitiesLoreConcept.name: Affinities
GLOBAL.AffinitiesLoreConcept.description:
The six affinities are the cosmic forces that shape and define all that exists. Order, Chaos, Nature, Shadow, Materium and Astral are the powers that encompass the cosmos, each vastly different in its domain, applications and nature. When channeling magic, the aspects of these cosmic forces will be invoked.

The Godir Lore are dedicated to studying the six affinities in order to harness their powers to the greatest effect. Their findings are inscribed in Tome Lore, true testaments to the godly ambitions of their authors.

GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept.name: Allfather
GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept.description:
The "Allfather" is one of the names given to a supreme being shrouded in mystery. Worshiped as a force of creation, they are known by many different identities throughout the cosmos. Some say they shaped the mythical Well of Creation while others believe that the being and the Well form a holy duality that cannot be separated.

The Archons Lore have spread the faith of the "Allfather" to many Worlds, the being's manifestation morphing toward the perception of the various races. While the Archons Lore claim to be the "Allfather's" celestial servants, there are no trustworthy sources that would demonstrate the being's intentions or any will to interfere with the dealings of mortals.

GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept.name: Ancient Krazura
GLOBAL.AncientKrazuraLoreConcept.description:
In ages past, long before the rise of the Godir Lore on Magehaven Lore, the Ancient Krazura were the sages of the Astral Sea Lore, knowledgeable and gifted in the arcane unlike any others. Their counsel and magecraft was sought by many, above all by the Archons Lore who grew to depend on the Ancient Krazura during the Endailon Crisis Lore. Together they devised the Vaultsphere, the World Seals and eventually Grexolis Lore, bringing an end to the Endailon Crisis Lore and largely restoring Archon order on the Worlds Within Lore.

Around that time, however, the Ancient Krazura mysteriously vanished and any record of their civilization and works became lost in the ages to follow. Only after the opening of Grexolis Lore and the return of the Endailon Lore is their history and heritage being rediscovered.

GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept.name: Archons
GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept.description: The Archons believe they were created by the Allfather Lore himself as the first sentient race, and tasked with advancing his works of creation. Through the ages, they have proudly called themselves the Allfather's divine guardians against evil, protecting new Worlds from the dangers of the Astral Sea Lore. However, in recent ages they have withdrawn from many Worlds and only rarely seek contact with the non-celestial races.

GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept.name: Archvampire
GLOBAL.ArchvampireLoreConcept.description: A myth even among Vampires themselves, the Archvampires are said to have been bitten by the Deathless God, the very first Vampire to roam the Worlds Within Lore. They are ancient and proud, dismissing the Elder Vampire Lore that sprang from their own fangs. Or so it is told in the tales of the Crimson Reign. Yet the Deathless God, his dominion and consorts all vanished in the mists of time.

GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept.name: Ascended Champion
GLOBAL.AscendedChampLoreConcept.description: Ascended Champions are mortals who joined the Pantheon of Godir at Magehaven Lore through their mastery of the arcane arts. They bear resemblance to their mortal origins and have a close connection with and understanding of the people they rule.

GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept.name: Astral Flows
GLOBAL.AstralFlowsLoreConcept.description: The Astral Flows are the magical currents within the Astral Sea Lore that connect all worlds and living beings. Where these flows breach the material realm they consolidate their magic into Mana Nodes. Here, magic users can tap into the flow to power their spells. Powerful beings may enter the Astral Sea Lore through these breaches to follow the Astral Flows to other worlds.

GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.name: Astral Sea
GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.description:
The Astral Sea is the primal source of arcane powers, a vast aetherial ocean containing and connecting the Worlds Within Lore. This ocean ebbs and flows, pushes and pulls, seeps into the material world through Mana Nodes. It contains beings of pure magical energy such as the Node Serpent and is traversed by the souls of the dead on their final journey to The Well Lore.

Powerful mages may follow the Astral Flows Lore to travel between worlds, but it is a dangerous journey where they may be lured away into the Astral Void Lore or become a victim of Astral Monsters Lore. A much safer method involves the use of World Gate Lore, which however require great knowledge and skill to be created or used.

GLOBAL.AstralDwellersLoreConcept.name: Astral Sea Dwellers
GLOBAL.AstralDwellersLoreConcept.description: Though alien to most visitors from the Worlds Within Lore, the Astral Sea Lore is not empty or dead. In between its Astral Flows Lore, an entire ecosystem thrives, where creatures and plants intertwine with the arcane energy as it ebbs and flows.
