GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.name: Production Queue
GLOBAL.ProductionQueueConcept.description:
Production Queues in City allow for the construction of City Structure and recruitment of Unit.

Structure Production and Unit Production resources are used up when building the first item in the Production Queue. Items in the queue can be reprioritized after being added.

GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.name: Race Transformation
GLOBAL.RaceTransformationConcept.description:
A powerful Spell that transforms the essence of an entire race, granting a bonus to all the race's units, even those not under the caster's control.
The caster must be the race's Keeper.A race can have any number of Minor Race Transformations at once.A race can have only one Major Race Transformation at a time.

GLOBAL.RazingConcept.name: Razing
GLOBAL.RazingConcept.description:
Army can remove an empire's Domain from a province by razing the Outpost or City at its center. Province Improvement cannot be razed, but can be Pillaged instead.

Razing cities leaves behind ruins which can be rebuilt at the cost of Imperium.

GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.name: Rally of the Lieges
GLOBAL.RequestMilitaryAidConcept.description:
This is where you can draft Unit into your empire or to help defend Vassal Cities using Recruitment Points.

The pool of available units consists primarily of units made available to you by loyal City and annexed Ancient Wonder. The number of units available depends on how many Recruitment Points you have available. The units made available by cities will be randomly selected based on the units that city can produce, focusing on higher tier units.

Rallies will be held every 15 Turn and only at that point will the pool of units and the number of points you can spend refresh. You can, however, use a boost to halve the amount of remaining turns once per Rally.

GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.name: Ritual of Alacrity
GLOBAL.RitualAlacrityConcept.description: Units standing on the center of this city or outpost restore {hppercentage} Hit Point, {mppercentage} Move Point, and remove P R O P E R T I E S. E X H A U S T E D from Speed March. The city or outpost has a {turn} Turn cooldown before it can use this again.

GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.name: Ruler in the Void
GLOBAL.RulerVoidConcept.description: When a Leader perishes during battle or otherwise, they will be cast into the Astral Void Lore. If that Ruler still holds their Throne City, they will materialize there in 3 Turn. If that Ruler has lost their Throne City, their Empire is defeated. While in the Void, the Ruler's empire is in chaos and subject to the following penalties:-20 City Stability in each city.Governor bonuses are not applied.Research is paused.No Spell can be cast.Active Magic Victory spells are canceled and their progress reset.

GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.name: Scout Prospecting
GLOBAL.ScoutProspectingConcept.description:
When Industrious P R O P E R T I E S. S C O U T_ U N I T stand within a friendly or neutral Province that contains a Cliff, Mountain or Stalagmite, the player that owns the P R O P E R T I E S. S C O U T_ U N I T can prospect the Province for Structure Production or Gold rewards.

Each Province can only be prospected once.

GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.name: Sensing Range
GLOBAL.SensorRangeConcept.description: Sensing Range is the number of hexes within which the presence of Unit can be detected in the Fog Of War.

GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.name: Siege
GLOBAL.SiegeConcept.description:
If a City has a City Wall Structure and you wish to conquer it, you first need to besiege it and breach its defenses.

A Siege can be initiated by attacking any of the 7 City hexes with at least 1 Army led by a Hero which must remain adjacent to the city until the siege is completed or else the Siege is lifted.

While sieging the City's Fortification Health is lowered by the besieger's Fortification Damage.

Siege Project can be used to speed up the siege by dealing more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Once Fortification Health reaches 0, the attacker can move into the City for a decisive battle.

GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.name: Siege Project
GLOBAL.SiegeProjectConcept.description:
Siege Projects can be used during a Siege to speed up the siege by adding more Fortification Damage. They can also remove defenses and give the besieger an advantage.

Siege Projects can only be added and removed in the Turn the Siege was initiated.

You can only have as many siege projects added as you can have slots. More slots can be gained through Empire Skill.

GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.name: Special Province Improvement
GLOBAL.SpecialImprovementConcept.description:
Special Province Improvement are built from the Production Queue and replace an existing Province Improvement.

Effects can include:Improved income based on adjacent Province.Army effects in and around the Special Province Improvement.Army spawn points.Army visit bonuses.

Special Province Improvements are unlocked with Tome and cultures.

GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.name: Spell Slot
GLOBAL.SpellSlotsConcept.description: Spell slots are used to prepare spells ready for casting. Once your spell slots are full you will need to cast or cancel a prepared spell before you can start preparing any new spells. You can gain another spell slot by building the S T R U C T U R E_ U P G R A D E S. C H A N N E L I N G C H A M B E R in your Throne City.

GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.name: Spell Victory
GLOBAL.SpellVictoryConcept.description: Casting this spell has a global effect and is required to reach Magic Victory.This spell requires time to channel once cast.

GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.name: Starvation
GLOBAL.StarvationConcept.description:
When Population Upkeep is higher than Food income, the city's Population will starve.

Starvation leads to Population dying and a Province Improvement leaving the city every {turntimer} <<Turn>>

GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.name: World Map
GLOBAL.WorldMapConcept.description: The World Map is where City are built, Army are moved, and Location are explored.

GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.name: Summon Spell
GLOBAL.StrategicSummonSpellConcept.description: Summons a Unit with P R O P E R T I E S. M A G I C_ O R I G I N.Can be cast on any hex adjacent to your heroes, ruler, or one of your cities.Units with P R O P E R T I E S. L A N D_ M O V E M E N T cannot be summoned onto water hexes.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.name: Structure Queue
GLOBAL.StructureQueueConcept.description: The Structure Queue is where City Structure are built by spending Gold and Structure Production.

GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.name: Sustained City Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedCitySpellConcept.description: Can affect the targeted city and its domain.The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.name: Sustained World Spell
GLOBAL.SustainedWorldSpellConcept.description: The effect lasts as long as you pay mana each turn.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.name: Swallowed
GLOBAL.SwallowedConcept.description: <bulletlist><bullet>Unit is removed from combat.</bullet><bullet>If another unit is swallowed, the previous swallowed unit dies.</bullet><bullet>If the unit that ate the unit is killed, the last unit swallowed is released.</bullet></bulletlist>

GLOBAL.CombatConcept.name: Combat
GLOBAL.CombatConcept.description:
Combat occurs when an Army encounters an enemy Army, or while exploring Ancient Wonder.

Combat occurs on a separate map and is Turn-based.

With the Reinforcement Rule, up to 6 armies can participate in the battle.

The battle is won by the last combatant that has Unit left.

GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.name: Terraforming Spell
GLOBAL.TerraformingSpellConcept.description: Terraforms one or more Province.Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.name: Throne City
GLOBAL.ThroneCityConcept.description: Your Throne City is the capital of your Empire. Losing it and your Leader simultaneously ends your Empire.

GLOBAL.TomeConcept.name: Tome
GLOBAL.TomeConcept.description:
A Tome is a collection of Spell, Unit and other skills that you can Research. Tomes also have initial bonuses you get for free.

Tier 1 tomes are always available, to unlock higher tier tomes:Research 2 Tomes of any tier.Tier 3 tomes require you to have {req3} points of a single Affinity.Tier 4 tomes require you to have {req} points of a single Affinity.Tier 5 Tomes require you to have {req2} points of a single Affinity.
Tomes can contain:SpellUnitSpecial ImprovementCity StructureSiege Project

GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.name: Tome Passive
GLOBAL.TomePassiveConcept.description: A passive bonus that is immediately active once the tome has been chosen.

GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.name: Tooltip
GLOBAL.TooltipConcept.description: Well done! Use this useful feature to learn about concepts and systems as you go. You can string together tooltips endlessly, however older ones will close as you go deeper.

GLOBAL.TurnConcept.name: Turn
GLOBAL.TurnConcept.description:
The unit of time in which Player carry out all of their actions.

On the World Map, turns take the form of either Classic Turn or Simultaneous Turn.

Turns during Combat are taken one Player after another.

GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.name: Underground
GLOBAL.UndergroundConcept.description: The layer of the World Map that can be accessed with Underground Passages.

GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.name: Uninhabited Province
GLOBAL.UninhabitedProvinceConcept.description: An uninhabited province is a province that isn't part of anyone's Domain and doesn't contain an Ancient Wonder.

GLOBAL.UnitConcept.name: Unit
GLOBAL.UnitConcept.description:
Units are the forces that make up your Army.

Units can explore the World Map and engage in Combat.

Can be recruited in City or summoned using Spell.

Units require Gold or Mana upkeep each Turn.

GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Enchantment Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpgradeUpkeepConcept.description: Each Unit Enchantment has its own upkeep cost in Gold and Mana which is added to the Unit Upkeep of each Unit that is using it.

GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.name: Unit Upkeep
GLOBAL.UnitUpkeepConcept.description:
Each Turn on the World Map, you must pay Gold and Mana to maintain your Unit. High tier units also require Imperium. If you cannot afford this, your units will lose Unit Morale!

A unit's upkeep depends on: Unit TierUnit Enchantment
Some Empire Skills and Hero Skills can reduce the Gold and Mana upkeep, but never below 50% of its value.

GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.name: Viability
GLOBAL.CallToArmsViabilityConcept.description:
Viability describes how likely it is for a Leader to complete the Call To Arms objective.
Other Rulers may not be at war with you if they want to accept the bounty. They must also have met the target Ruler or Independent City, and AI controlled Rulers must be at war with the target.

For AI controlled Rulers, their army power and proximity to the target are also taken into account, as well as how strongly the target is defended. The viability also influences the chances of AI controlled Rulers accepting the bounty.

GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.name: Vision Range
GLOBAL.VisionRangeConcept.description: Vision Range is the number of hexes that remove Fog Of War.

GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.name: World Map Spell
GLOBAL.WorldMapSpellConcept.description:
These are Spell that are cast on the World Map, using World Map Casting Point.

Types of World Map Spells are:City SpellEnemy Army SpellFriendly Army SpellMajor Race TransformationMinor Race TransformationSpell VictoryStrategic Summon SpellSustained City SpellSustained World SpellTerraforming SpellUnit EnchantmentWorld Spell

GLOBAL.WorldSpellConcept.name: World Spell
GLOBAL.WorldSpellConcept.description: Costs Mana and World Map Casting Point.

GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.name: Race Relation Reward
GLOBAL.RaceRelationRewardConcept.description: This quest hands out race relation as a guaranteed reward. This means all owned City of that race will receive a temporary City Stability bonus, and all met Independent City receive a Independent City Relation bonus.

GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.name: Unknown Bonus
GLOBAL.SurpriseBonusRewardConcept.description: Unknown rewards can be earned after completion.

GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.name: Mystery Bonus
GLOBAL.MysteryBonusRewardConcept.description: Bonus rewards can be earned through different story event choices after completion.

GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.name: Outnumbered
GLOBAL.OutnumberedConcept.description: A unit is outnumbered if the number of units on the opposing side is greater than the number of units on their own side.

GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.name: Unknown Trait
GLOBAL.UnknownTraitConcept.description: Unknown traits are hidden when the game begins, and are slowly revealed as it progresses.

GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.name: Cavern Floor
GLOBAL.CavernFloorConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Rough, nearly barren rock. A Hut can be built here.
Underground-adapted factions can build a Farm here instead.

GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.name: Diggable Earth
GLOBAL.DiggableEarthConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Can be Excavated one Province at a time by Unit once the Excavation Empire Skill is acquired.

GLOBAL.SwampConcept.name: Swamp
GLOBAL.SwampConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

Swampy marshlands. A Farm can be built here, but factions without Swamp Adaptation will suffer {fooddebuff} Food.

GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.name: Underground Water
GLOBAL.UndergroundWaterConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

A province of water in the underground. A water Farm can be built here.

GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.name: Uninhabitable
GLOBAL.UninhabitableConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

This province is uninhabitable. You cannot build an Outpost here, nor can you annex this Province to a City.

GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.name: Marauder
GLOBAL.MarauderConcept.description: Marauders are hostile Army threatening the World Map that are not affiliated with a Independent City or Empire.

GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.name: Mangrove Forest
GLOBAL.MangroveForestConcept.description:
A water Province Feature.

A forest with its roots submerged in water. A water Forester can be built here.

GLOBAL.VoidConcept.name: Void
GLOBAL.VoidConcept.description:
A Province Feature.

A void is present in the province which blocks all movement and cannot be built upon.

GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.name: Terraforming
GLOBAL.TerraformingConcept.description:
Terraforming effects can change the appearance and Province Feature in a Province. Terraforming can change what Province Improvement can be built in a Province, but does not destroy or change already built Province Improvements.

When terraforming originates from a source, such as a City or Province Improvement, then removing the source will revert the terraforming effects. When there is no source that can be removed, terraforming is permanent until overwritten by a new terraforming effect.

World Map Spell can apply terraforming effects. When you cancel a sustained effect such as a Sustained World Spell, its terraforming changes will not be reverted.

Certain provinces or features, such as Lava, Water, and Uninhabitable provinces, cannot normally be terraformed.
